import anndata as ad
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import sparse

fn='covid.patients.q1.h5ad'
adata=ad.read_h5ad(fn, backed='r')
obs=adata.obs.copy()
# numeric donor order
donors=sorted(obs['donor_id'].astype(str).unique(), key=lambda s:int(s.replace('donor','')))
donor_to_i={d:i for i,d in enumerate(donors)}
codes=np.array([donor_to_i[x] for x in obs['donor_id'].astype(str)], dtype=np.int32)
ng=adata.n_vars; nd=len(donors)
sums=np.zeros((nd,ng), dtype=np.float64)
cell_counts=np.bincount(codes, minlength=nd)
# per donor number of detected cells for selected genes later: aggregate full binary maybe too big; use expr count for all genes uint32 ok 33*13k
detected=np.zeros((nd,ng), dtype=np.uint32)
block=2500
for start in range(0, adata.n_obs, block):
    end=min(start+block, adata.n_obs)
    X=adata.X[start:end]
    if hasattr(X,'to_memory'):
        X=X.to_memory()
    X=X.tocsr()
    c=codes[start:end]
    G=sparse.csr_matrix((np.ones(end-start, dtype=np.float64),(np.arange(end-start), c)), shape=(end-start, nd))
    sums += (G.T @ X).toarray()
    B=X.copy(); B.data=np.ones_like(B.data, dtype=np.uint8)
    detected += (G.T @ B).toarray().astype(np.uint32)
    if start%(25000)==0: print('processed', end, flush=True)

names=np.array(adata.var['feature_name'].astype(str).values)
idx={g:i for i,g in enumerate(names)}
lib=sums.sum(axis=1)
cpm=sums/lib[:,None]*1e6
logcpm=np.log1p(cpm)
# save compact outputs for reuse
np.savez('donor_pseudobulk.npz', sums=sums, detected=detected, cell_counts=cell_counts, names=names, donors=np.array(donors), lib=lib)

gene_sets={
 'ISG_core':['IFI27','IFI6','ISG15','MX1','OAS1','OAS2','OAS3','IFIT1','IFIT2','IFIT3','RSAD2','SIGLEC1','LY6E','STAT1','IRF7','XAF1','USP18','IFI44L','IFI44'],
 'COVID_inflam':['IL1B','S100A8','S100A9','LST1','FCGR3A','FCN1','LGALS3','TYROBP','CTSS','CST3','CXCL10','CCL2','CCL3','CCL4','CCL7','TNF'],
 'Tcell':['CD3D','CD3E','TRAC','IL7R','CCR7','LTB'],
 'Bcell':['MS4A1','CD79A','CD79B','BANK1'],
 'Mono':['LYZ','S100A8','S100A9','FCN1','LST1','CTSS'],
 'Platelet':['PPBP','PF4','NRGN'],
 'RBC':['HBB','HBA1','HBA2'],
 'NK':['NKG7','GNLY','PRF1','KLRD1'],
}
rows=[]
for d_i,d in enumerate(donors):
    row={'donor':d, 'id':int(d.replace('donor','')), 'cells':int(cell_counts[d_i]), 'lib':lib[d_i]}
    for setname, genes in gene_sets.items():
        present=[idx[g] for g in genes if g in idx]
        row[setname]=float(logcpm[d_i,present].mean()) if present else np.nan
        # fraction of cells expressing at least each gene avg
        row[setname+'_pct']=float((detected[d_i,present]/cell_counts[d_i]).mean()) if present else np.nan
    rows.append(row)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('id')
for col in ['ISG_core','ISG_core_pct','COVID_inflam','COVID_inflam_pct','Mono','Tcell','Bcell','NK']:
    df[col+'_z']=(df[col]-df[col].mean())/df[col].std(ddof=0)
print(df[['id','donor','cells','ISG_core','ISG_core_pct','COVID_inflam','COVID_inflam_pct','Mono','Tcell','Bcell','NK']].to_string(index=False))
print('\\nSorted by ISG_core:')
print(df.sort_values('ISG_core')[['id','ISG_core','ISG_core_pct','COVID_inflam','COVID_inflam_pct','Mono','Tcell','Bcell','NK']].to_string(index=False))

    top_neg=order[np.argsort(comp)[:20]]
    print('\\nPC',pc+1,'pos', list(names[top_pos]))
    print('PC',pc+1,'neg', list(names[top_neg]))

import anndata as ad
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import sparse
adata=ad.read_h5ad('covid.patients.q1.h5ad', backed='r')
obs=adata.obs.copy(); donors=sorted(obs['donor_id'].astype(str).unique(), key=lambda s:int(s.replace('donor',''))); ids=[int(d.replace('donor','')) for d in donors]
donor_to_i={d:i for i,d in enumerate(donors)}; codes=np.array([donor_to_i[x] for x in obs['donor_id'].astype(str)], dtype=np.int32)
names=np.array(adata.var['feature_name'].astype(str).values); idx={g:i for i,g in enumerate(names)}
markers={
 'T_naive':['CD3D','CD3E','IL7R','CCR7','LTB','TCF7','LEF1'],
 'T_cyto_NK':['NKG7','GNLY','GZMB','PRF1','KLRD1','CD3D'],
 'Mono_inflam':['LYZ','S100A8','S100A9','FCN1','LST1','CTSS','LGALS3','CD14'],
 'B':['MS4A1','CD79A','CD79B','BANK1'],
 'Plasma':['MZB1','JCHAIN','XBP1','DERL3'],
 'Platelet':['PPBP','PF4','NRGN'],
 'Cycling':['MKI67','TOP2A','STMN1','UBE2C','PCNA'],
 'ISG':['IFI27','IFI6','ISG15','MX1','OAS1','IFIT1','IFIT3','RSAD2','SIGLEC1','LY6E'],
}
marker_idx={k:[idx[g] for g in v if g in idx] for k,v in markers.items()}
# classify by marker score among cell types, plus flags for ISG/cycling per cell
classes=['T_naive','T_cyto_NK','Mono_inflam','B','Plasma','Platelet']
counts=np.zeros((len(donors), len(classes)), dtype=np.int64)
flags=np.zeros((len(donors),3), dtype=np.int64) # ISG, cycling, plasma strong
cell_counts=np.bincount(codes, minlength=len(donors))
block=5000
for start in range(0, adata.n_obs, block):
    end=min(start+block, adata.n_obs)
    cols=sorted(set(sum(marker_idx.values(), [])))
    X=adata.X[start:end, cols]
    if hasattr(X,'to_memory'): X=X.to_memory()
    X=X.tocsr()
    pos={c:j for j,c in enumerate(cols)}
    score=np.zeros((end-start, len(classes)), dtype=np.float32)
    for ci,cl in enumerate(classes):
        ps=[pos[j] for j in marker_idx[cl]]
        if ps: score[:,ci]=np.asarray(X[:,ps].sum(axis=1)).ravel()/len(ps)
    assigned=score.argmax(axis=1)
    maxscore=score.max(axis=1)
    # require any marker expression; else no assignment
    for local_i,(a,ms) in enumerate(zip(assigned,maxscore)):
        if ms>0:
            counts[codes[start+local_i], a]+=1
    # flags raw avg expression > thresholds roughly any strong marker
    for fi,cl in enumerate(['ISG','Cycling','Plasma']):
        ps=[pos[j] for j in marker_idx[cl]]
        if ps:
            vals=np.asarray(X[:,ps].sum(axis=1)).ravel()
            # >=1 total marker UMI
            for local_i,val in enumerate(vals):
                if val>=1: flags[codes[start+local_i], fi]+=1
props=counts/cell_counts[:,None]
flagp=flags/cell_counts[:,None]
df=pd.DataFrame({'id':ids,'cells':cell_counts})
for i,c in enumerate(classes): df[c]=props[:,i]
for i,c in enumerate(['ISG_any','Cycling_any','Plasma_any']): df[c]=flagp[:,i]
print(df.sort_values('id').to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda x:f'{x:.3f}'))
print('\\nhealthy candidate means vs rest')
healthy={1,5,11,12,17,21,24,27,29,32}
for group,name in [(healthy,'cand'),(set(ids)-healthy,'rest')]:
    sub=df[df.id.isin(group)]
    print(name, sub[['T_naive','T_cyto_NK','Mono_inflam','B','Plasma','Platelet','ISG_any','Cycling_any','Plasma_any']].mean().to_string())
